inherited_release_gate.note: All sealed dev27 SHAD/MTRL/BONE/PARE scene-graph synchronization, dev26 MESH/ARRY synchronization, dev25 retail GMX evidence, GUI/mod-package/native-builder/research/extraction/source-only gates are inherited. Dev28 adds opt-in TXIF reference creation and glTF texture binding without modifying dev27.

compatible MTRL DiffuseSampler is rewired to the new TXIF

dev28_gmx_texture_graph_sync.inherited_external_retail_gate: dev25 306/306 mesh-bearing GMX no-op byte-identical plus plr_001 topology smoke
dev28_gmx_texture_graph_sync.boundary: TXIF reference/binding synthesis is structurally regression-tested; native texture payload replacement remains a separate workflow and arbitrary material/vertex schemas, animation graph synthesis, shader compilation, template-free GMX construction and synthesized-scene runtime acceptance remain unresolved.

fresh_package.note: Candidate was extracted fresh, verified against RELEASE_MANIFEST with no missing/mismatched/unlisted files, source-audited before executing package code, then passed 74/74 selftests and CLI/GUI version checks. The final package is rebuilt deterministically after recording these candidate results and is revalidated separately.

limitations: Dev28 TXIF reference/binding synthesis is structurally regression-tested but has not yet been exercised as an arbitrary synthesized texture/scene graph on retail hardware/emulator.
TXIF creation creates the GMX reference record only; the referenced native TEX/DDS payload must be created/replaced through the separate texture asset workflow.
Synthesized MESH/ARRY nodes and MTRL parameter schemas still clone compatible native donor layouts; arbitrary vertex declarations and material parameter schemas are not implemented.
SHAD synthesis covers the known fixed native identity/name/flags record; platform shader bytecode compilation is not implemented.
The external dev25 retail 306/306 no-op and plr_001 topology evidence is inherited rather than re-bundled or re-run from proprietary inputs in this release tree.
PS3 NPDRM/SDAT re-encryption is not implemented.
Audio replacement/rebuilding remains intentionally deferred by current project priority.
